name: Shopping App
summary: Autonomous shopping assistant on a dedicated server. Searches Tesco, Sainsbury's, Amazon, and eBay — compares prices, manages a basket, and remembers your preferences. Powered by Claude.

components.notes: Node.js shopping server: /api/chat with Claude tool-use loop, /api/basket, /api/preferences, and static UI serving.
uk-grocery-cli groc-api sidecar on port 7876. Provides live Tesco and Sainsbury's search. Falls back to mock data if not running.
Writes the Anthropic API key into /opt/shopping-app/.env so the gateway can call Claude.
React + Vite dark-theme chat UI. Basket sidebar with per-store checkout links, product result cards, and quick-start prompts. Built on the VPS.
